hook: Pensioners: life certificate by *face scan* till Nov 30
hook_b: Pensioners: life certificate by *face scan* till Nov 30
tldr: The Department of Pension and Pensioners' Welfare is running a Digital Life Certificate campaign in Hyderabad from Nov 1 to 30 using Aadhaar-based face authentication on Android phones.

beats.what: SBI at its local head office and India Post Payments Bank at the General Post Office are running camps.
beats.why: Pensioners must submit a life certificate; face authentication lets them do it on a smartphone.
beats.care: If a parent or grandparent draws a central pension, this is the window to help them file.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Senior Director (IT) Anil Bansal visited the SBI and IPPB camps on Thursday.

cards.q: Has anyone in your family filed a digital life certificate?

qs: How many Hyderabad pensioners have filed digitally this month?

facts.t: Digital life certificates began in *2014* with biometric devices; face scan came later with MeitY and UIDAI.

viz.verdict: Officials want pensioners to file on their own in future.

watch: Camps run until Nov 30 at SBI's local head office and the GPO.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Digital Life Certificate campaign in Hyderabad to help central government pensioners use face authentication

fact: Central pensioners in Hyderabad can file life certificates by face scan till *Nov 30*
twist: Officials are also visiting *super-senior and disabled* pensioners at home to generate certificates.
